Title: Generally Available: Azure Functions support for PowerShell 7.6

Body.Content:
Azure Functions support for PowerShell 7.6 is now generally available.  

You can now develop apps using PowerShell 7.6 locally and deploy them to Azure Functions plans.  

 Learn more: 

  • Updating your app to PowerShell 7.6  
  • What's new in PowerShell 7.6?  
  • Azure Functions PowerShell versions and their end of support dates
